policy.selection: one shared step per recipe; mean(draws) per seed then mean(seeds)
policy.alternate: evaluate exact frozen step; no alternate checkpoint/recipe selection
policy.duration_transfer: same optimizer updates AND full LR horizon on every fold/final
policy.mvp: historical outer-selected reference; NOT unbiased independent test
policy.masks: automatic anonymized-region diagnostic, NOT verified plate-only
policy.junk: unchanged official adapter; extra same-camera diagnostic only

comparison_plan.threshold_rule: calibration only; maximize C=.7F1+.3TNR, ties F1 then higher threshold
comparison_plan.runtime: primary weights: original torch device; saved ONNX: explicit CPUExecutionProvider
comparison_plan.scope: already observed outer development data; not an independent or hidden-test estimate

comparison.note: descriptive post-selection comparison; repeated episodes are not independent identities

source_selection.scope: post-hoc development search, not an independent confirmation or hidden-test estimate

roles.confidence: maximum raw cosine of R1 block only

calibration.method: maximize C=0.7F1+0.3TNR; ties F1 then higher threshold

dual_role_plan.scope: fixed post-hoc development system; both splits already observed, not independent test

map_search_plan.selection: maximum calibration mAP over all five systems; exact ties retain v25 first
map_search_plan.candidate: unchanged v24 R1 raw_top1, confidence and frozen threshold
map_search_plan.validation: baseline and one calibration winner only
map_search_plan.scope: observed development splits, not an independent test; no automatic promotion

fusion_extension_plan.reason: v25 winner reached the highest tested R1 weight; extend calibration search to 100%
fusion_extension_plan.validation: current v25 baseline plus one calibration winner; no automatic promotion

late_fusion_plan.graphs: independent MVP and R1 static galleries; k1=20, k2=3; MVP lambda=.5, R1=.5/.75
late_fusion_plan.fusion: distance mean or weighted reciprocal rank with k=10/60; full gallery before top10
late_fusion_plan.candidate: unchanged raw R1 cosine, candidate and frozen threshold
late_fusion_plan.selection: maximum calibration mAP; ties retain v25 first
late_fusion_plan.validation: v25 control and one calibration winner only; no automatic promotion
late_fusion_plan.scope: adaptive search on observed development splits, not an independent hidden test

multi_hypothesis_plan.selection: maximum calibration mAP across the complete fixed grid; ties v25 first
multi_hypothesis_plan.validation: v25 control and one overall winner only, no family winner sweep
multi_hypothesis_plan.candidate: original full R1 raw_top1/cosine, unchanged threshold; never TTA
multi_hypothesis_plan.gallery_center: per-block mean of static gallery only; no query statistics, labels or updates
multi_hypothesis_plan.power: signed abs(x)**gamma then per-block L2; experimental adaptation, not RootSIFT
multi_hypothesis_plan.flip: horizontal mirror of each organizer crop after fixed preprocessing; same transform for q/g
multi_hypothesis_plan.scope: adaptive search on observed development splits, not independent hidden-test evidence

finalists_plan.calibration: replay exactly three existing results, using the saved v28 flip cache
finalists_plan.validation: compare exactly v25, power_50_l50 and flip_mvp_w75_l50; no further tuning
finalists_plan.scope: post-hoc development comparison, not an independent hidden-test estimate

pool_rerank_plan.pool: top K of original normalized MVP/R1 50:50 cosine fusion; K=10/20/50
pool_rerank_plan.reranking: restrict full static-gallery v25 k20/k3/lambda.50 order to the raw pool
pool_rerank_plan.tail: unchanged raw-fusion order outside the pool; no outsiders enter the pool
pool_rerank_plan.candidate: original raw R1 candidate/cosine/refusal and frozen threshold
pool_rerank_plan.selection: maximum calibration mAP over all four systems; ties retain v25 first
pool_rerank_plan.validation: v25 and one frozen calibration winner only; no automatic promotion
pool_rerank_plan.scope: post-hoc search on observed development data, not independent hidden-test evidence

multiscale_plan.input_adaptation: ONNX input H/W only; graph operators, constants and weights unchanged; in-memory copies
multiscale_plan.preprocessing: same organizer bbox, RGB, bilinear square resize and ImageNet normalization
multiscale_plan.graph: full static gallery, k1=20, k2=3, lambda=.50; no pool restriction
multiscale_plan.candidate: unchanged original R1_256 raw candidate/cosine/frozen threshold
multiscale_plan.selection: maximum calibration mAP over all five systems; exact ties retain v25 first
multiscale_plan.validation: v25 and one calibration winner; high-resolution extraction for selected size only
multiscale_plan.scope: post-hoc development search; not independent hidden-test evidence
